description: A bearded man in a round-brimmed cap and a fringed, draped wool robe stands on a raised terrace in the foreground, his arm extended and pointing to the right. Behind him, a crowd of helmeted soldiers with long spears and round shields fills the lower half. In the background are mud-brick buildings, a stepped ziggurat-like tower, and a river reflecting a dusk sky of orange and dark grey clouds. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no visible text, border or signature.
